description: register.tsx (the "modules" entry above) is every hook this plugin has, as native function hooks: the plan band and the Plan pane, the plan event relay, the time stamp on every prompt and tool call, the registry's event text for a plan-connected session (session start, resume, compaction, every sub-agent), the restart notice, and the reports a plan-connected session sends the dashboard through the plugin's own danxbot_api tool (sub-agent and background-shell activity, the running background-work count, and the ready-cards check that blocks a stop once while the plan has ready, unclaimed cards). It is tested by `claude plugin test danxbot` and validated by `claude plugin validate danxbot` before every publish (publish.sh needs the claude CLI: set CLAUDE_BIN when it is not on PATH). The danx-dashboard MCP server's launcher (scripts/dashboard-mcp-server.mjs) starts the recorded danx-dashboard-mcp version, installing it first when missing, and refreshes the record from the npm registry's latest in the background, so a new release runs from the next session start.
